title: 1991 Score Rookie Prospect Tim McIntosh #347 Milwaukee Brewers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1991 Score Tim McIntosh #347 Milwaukee Brewers trading card is a must-have for any baseball fan. Featuring the Brewers player in his prime, this card is a great addition to any collection. The card is part of the 1991 Score set and has been well-preserved over the years, making it an excellent investment for collectors.

The card showcases McIntosh's talent and skill on the field, making it a valuable item for fans of the Milwaukee Brewers. With its unique features, including the team name, card number, and season, this trading card is a rare find for any collector. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this timeless piece to your collection.
